title: docs: link reviewed status from research glossary
body:
## Summary

The research glossary now links readers to the [current reviewed status](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90/docs/research/current-status.md) for frozen checkpoints and remaining obligations, and to [current priorities](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90/docs/research/current-priorities.md) for the live candidate and queue. The status link sits beside first-session terminology without changing shared source guidance that historical research packages pin as input.

At the pinned base, revision-6 priorities link a supporting review through #2027, while the current-status index includes the later efficient1900 review in progress. The index labels rows as frozen checkpoints and keeps the selected record authoritative. This adds navigation to that existing index; it does not change priorities or the selected result.

This complements the already merged status-index correction in [PR #2892](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2892), which reconciled later review records. The selected-CI navigation repair in [Discussion #2211](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2211) addresses a different route.

## Validation

- `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --changed-since 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 --matrix-batch-size 256` selected zero package replays for the final glossary-only diff.
- A local assertion confirmed both relative links resolve from the glossary.
- `git diff --check 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90..HEAD` passed.
- The full selected cold replay was not run.

No mathematical evidence, selected records, or frozen reviews changed.

Credit the prior index repair and retained authorship through PR #2892. Prepared by the assigned homelab-16 Codex worker with substantial AI assistance. Apache-2.0.
